prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects POST requests whose Accept header lists only `application/json` (current code requires both `application/json` AND `text/event-stream`), returning a spurious 406. prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 replaces the check with a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that splits the Accept header into media ranges, strips parameters, and excludes entries with q=0 before comparing exact type/subtype pairs. #2046 instead swaps in a plain acceptHeader?.includes('application/json') substring check, which will false-positive on any media type that merely contains that substring (e.g. application/json-patch+json, application/jsonlines) and does not honor q=0 exclusions. Same bug, same file/region touched — #1996's parser handles more of the Accept-header edge cases with the same or smaller risk of regressions elsewhere in the handler.
